title: Phone Cleanup Report
result: **The pop-ups have been stopped.** They came from a hidden Samsung Routine that opened a scam website every time the phone charged on Wi-Fi, and from spam websites allowed to send notifications in Chrome. Both have been removed, along with 6 unwanted apps.
findings: A fake routine named **"Playing games while charging"**. When charging on Wi-Fi it opened the scam site `gamesprinty.com`. It had been firing since June 2026.
**Deleted.** The only other routine (Save battery at night) is a Samsung default and is off.
2 spam "weather alert" sites were allowed to send pop-ups: `localweathertracker.com` and `yourweatherwatcher.com`.
**Removed.** Chrome now blocks all websites from asking to send notifications.
Leftover data from spam/ad sites `codefabricowl.com` (added Oct 5) and `travelnotle.com`.
6 unrecognized or abandoned apps, some from developers known for heavy advertising.
removed: Abandoned since 2022; developer known for aggressive ads
Shopping/deals app — common source of ads
Unrecognized "shield" utility app, not in use
Unrecognized scheduler app, not in use
checked: Only Waze, Google and Android itself — normal
**Kept.** Their full-screen ads stay inside the games — normal for free games
advice: If a website asks to **"Allow notifications"**, tap **Block** or **Don't allow**.
Never add a **Routine**, shortcut or "battery booster" that a website or ad offers you.
In free games, close ads with the small **X** — don't tap the ad itself.
Pop-ups again? Don't tap anything in them — **call us** and we'll take a look.
